scope: Game map completion rules; the viewer may count source locations separately from game item-ID deduplication.

sourceFields.saveGuid: SaveGuidString FName; no value becomes null
sourceFields.flowAsset: FlowAssetName FName; association only, not a prerequisite
sourceFields.weaponId: WeaponID FName for weapon and shaqiWeapon

bell.counting: Distinct BellID within selected map IDs.

weapon.counting: Distinct category item ID within selected map IDs; source-location counts can differ.

shaqiWeapon.counting: Distinct category item ID within selected map IDs; source-location counts can differ.

accessory.counting: Distinct category item ID within selected map IDs; source-location counts can differ.

medicine.counting: Distinct category item ID within selected map IDs; source-location counts can differ.

rongShu.unknownWhen: nodeGuids is empty or event section is absent.

longZhu.unknownWhen: nodeGuids is empty or event section is absent.

scarecrow.unknownWhen: nodeGuids is empty or event section is absent.

amber.actorCompatibility: Exact actor ID; for older saves allow unqualified Actor name versus level-qualified LevelPackage-ActorName; ambiguous suffix matches are unknown.
amber.counting: Every configured material record. Test is excluded by global total algorithm; other legacy-looking rows are not automatically excluded.

blackStone.actorCompatibility: Exact actor ID; for older saves allow unqualified Actor name versus level-qualified LevelPackage-ActorName; ambiguous suffix matches are unknown.
blackStone.counting: Every configured material record. Test is excluded by global total algorithm; other legacy-looking rows are not automatically excluded.

memoryFlower.counting: Every filtered source record, including petal records; composed parent flowers can be retained in catalog with gameCounted=false.
memoryFlower.unknownWhen: PropData or petal grouping cannot be resolved; inventory/cycle missing.

staticFilterEvidence.petalGrouping: Petal IntegrationItemID equals complete flower ItemID; order by SequentialIndex.

primary.counting: Not part of the seven-category game total; map marker only.
primary.unknownWhen: saveGuid is absent/None or actor section is absent. The game skips such records instead of proving them completed.

key.missingOnlyWhen: Inventory key absent AND a runtime SwitchLockObject in LockObjectInfos.MapLockGroups[0] needs itemId. hasSwitchLockObj ignores its mapID argument.
key.counting: Not part of the seven-category game total; map marker only.
key.offlineSemantics: Inventory key existence supports obtained; inventory absence alone is unknown. Actor/flow completion can be shown as supplemental evidence without calling it the exact game key rule.

limitations: A zero quantity does not erase acquisition history.
ExecuteNodeGuid completion is key existence; do not test its boolean value.
AcquiredCycle comparison requires a parsed current cycle; absent cycle information makes cycle-dependent results unknown.
Runtime lock object availability is not fully serialized; key markers need an unknown state when the item is absent but matching active lock cannot be established.
Static FlowAssetName and task names alone establish associations, not prerequisites.
Coordinates and straight-line nearest bells do not establish walkable routes.

catalogFlags.gameCounted: true/false/null for whether the source point participates in its game completion category; null means filtering cannot yet be established
catalogFlags.aggregationParent: Boolean: true only for a complete memory-flower parent (ItemType=4) with more than one configured petal. Petal parent IDs live in memoryFlower.parentId.
catalogFlags.requirements: Association metadata only unless relation is prerequisite. A flow asset ID is never an ExecuteNodeGuid key; compare source.nodeGuids for executed-node completion.
